rubric: ALLOW only a message explicitly reporting a current real physical fire and requesting immediate help. DENY negated reports, historical reports, hypotheticals, quotations, and planned fire drills. If whether a current real emergency is reported is ambiguous, return UNKNOWN.
matching_input: A real physical fire is burning in my room right now. Please send immediate help!
submitted_counterexample: There is no fire here; the fire drill is scheduled for next week.
